trap.label: passado simples
trap.wrong: In 1934 he has written his first book.
trap.right: In 1934 he wrote his first book.
trap.why: Em português o pretérito perfeito composto pode aparecer com data. Em inglês, com data específica no passado use past simple.

mcq.q: “By the age of ten, he ___ a prize.”
Which word shows what came later in a life story?

fix.wrong: In 1950 she has founded a school.
Although he was famous, but he was poor.
fix.right: Although he was famous, he was poor.

fix.wrong: He wrote and win a prize.
fix.right: He wrote and won a prize.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no past simple: “In 1934 he has won a prize.”
Una com although: “He was famous. He was poor.” (Although…)
rewrite.answer: Although he was famous, he was poor.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “She founds a school.”
